name: Mosaic
description: The view pans across a mosaic of rotated tiles from both clips and settles on the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: endx
params.description: Tile column the view ends on

params.name: endy
params.description: Tile row the view ends on (counted upward)
